notes: V30.39 removes all operational legacy optimisation paths from the UI and uses one ProbabilisticJointOptimizer runtime for both live acquisition and REVIEW. The estimator runs in explicit main-thread time slices to eliminate opaque module-worker startup failures. Every cycle logs evidence audit, baseline, per-step timing, candidate, gate and acceptance/rejection. No automatic post-scan optimiser is launched: additional global cycles are manual and use the same accepted state.
